effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom from caller), using the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
The vault mints vault shares (bbqUSDCreservoir) to `receiver`; the number is computed from storage (totalSupply, lastTotalAssets), with no minimum.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets; this does not change what the signer receives.
formats.shown: "Deposit" with 10 USDC as "Deposit asset", a fixed "Share ticker: reservoirUSDC" line and the share recipient, but no share amount.

findings.title: deposit shows share ticker "reservoirUSDC", but the vault token symbol is "bbqUSDCreservoir".
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "reservoirUSDC", shown in the deposit field "Share ticker". meta.json constructor __symbol = "bbqUSDCreservoir", __name = "Steakhouse Reservoir USDC". Case 0 mined: shares in with symbol "bbqUSDCreservoir".
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "bbqUSDCreservoir", the on-chain symbol the signer sees in the wallet balance.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). Case 0: signer receives 9.933415416519070396 bbqUSDCreservoir; the screen shows no share amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor; the amount is not in the calldata and the function has no minimum-shares argument.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name the asset or the vault, and the ticker line is a raw constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit intent "Deposit"; field {label "Share ticker", format raw, value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker}; no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC into vault" and add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for vault shares to {receiver}". Drop the raw ticker line or relabel it "Receive shares of".

cases.notes: USDC out 10 is shown exactly. Shares in: recipient shown, amount not shown, ticker shown as reservoirUSDC while the token symbol is bbqUSDCreservoir.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`; the number is computed from storage with rounding up, with no maximum.
If the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: "Withdraw" with "Withdraw exactly 44.223311 USDC", the recipient and the owner, but no count of shares burned.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the shares burned from the owner; the contract computes them from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); ERC4626._withdraw: _burn(owner, shares). Case 1: signer burns 43.436202217887842412 bbqUSDCreservoir, not on screen.
findings.fix: None for the amount. The intent can name the vault shares as the source.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" does not say vault shares are burned to pay the USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw intent "Withdraw", no interpolatedIntent. Case 1 reader: "the screen doesn't say exactly what is reduced", unsure "Which asset or shares are used up".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC by burning vault shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} from {owner}'s shares".

cases.notes: USDC in 44.223311 to the signer is shown exactly. Shares out (43.436 bbqUSDCreservoir) have no field; the reader guessed a reduced position without the asset or amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent by `shares`.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is computed from storage with rounding down, with no minimum.
formats.shown: "Redeem" with the share amount in reservoirUSDC, the recipient and the owner, but no USDC asset or amount received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset received; intent is only "Redeem".
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem intent "Redeem"; fields shares, receiver "To", owner; underlyingToken constant not used. Case 2 reader: "Some underlying asset (likely USDC)... exact amount and token not shown".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem vault shares for USDC" and the receiver label to "Send USDC to"; add interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor); ERC4626._withdraw: safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets). Case 2: signer receives 3.161595 USDC, not on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor; redeem has no minimum-assets argument.

findings.title: redeem renders shares as "reservoirUSDC", but the vault token symbol is "bbqUSDCreservoir".
findings.evidence: Case 2 screen: "3.10892697181701575 reservoirUSDC"; mined effect symbol "bbqUSDCreservoir"; meta.json __symbol "bbqUSDCreservoir". Descriptor constant vaultTicker "reservoirUSDC".
findings.fix: Align the vault ticker with the on-chain symbol "bbqUSDCreservoir" and update the test expectations.

cases.notes: Shares out 3.1089 are shown with the right amount (ticker label differs from on-chain symbol). USDC in 3.161595 has no field; reader guessed USDC without amount.
